Innovative, purpose-built IP video storage solutions.

### How to Get Started with ACSMI’s Cybersecurity Certification, Step-by-Step Process

Starting your cybersecurity career with ACSMI’s Advanced Cybersecurity & Management Certification is
simple and streamlined. Here’s how you can get started:

**ACSMI makes it easier than ever to transition from where you are now — to where cybersecurity’s
future needs you.**
* ## 01. Choose Your Enrollment Option:
  
  Select your preferred plan — full access, mentorship upgrade, or flexible 12-month payments
  starting at just $208/month.
  
  [Choose Your Enrollment Option]
* ## 02. Complete Your Registration
  
  Register securely through our online portal. You'll get instant access to your learning dashboard,
  course materials, and support channels.
  
  [Complete Your Registration]
* ## 03. Attend Orientation and Launch
  
  Start with a welcome session to map your learning path. Whether you choose the 8-week fast-track
  or 3–6 month self-paced option, you’ll have complete guidance from day one.
  
  [Attend Orientation and Launch]
* ## 04. Dive Into Interactive Learning
  
  Begin hands-on labs, CTF challenges, live webinars, and real-world simulations, all while building
  your cybersecurity portfolio.
  
  [Dive Into Interactive Learning]
* ## 05. Complete Certification Exams
  
  Defend a breach simulation, finish your capstone project, and prepare for certifications like
  CISSP, CEH, OSCP, and more
  
  [Complete Certification Exams]
* ## 06. Advance Your Career
  
  Walk away not just with a CPD-accredited certificate, but a battle-tested cybersecurity resume
  employers recognize and trust.
  
  [Advance Your Career]

preparation, just built around your reality, not someone else's.

Fast-Track Option

Complete your full certification in as little as **8 weeks** through an intensive, structured

[Self-Paced Flexibility]

Need balance? Take **3–6 months** to work through the curriculum around your job, family, or

**it prepares you to lead the future of security itself.**

Launch your career with leadership-grade credentials and skills that outpace entry-level
competition.

Break into cybersecurity fast with practical, recognized certification and hands-on proof you can
deliver.

[IT Professionals]

#### **IT Professionals**

Specialize and pivot toward six-figure cybersecurity roles, cloud security, ethical hacking, or
threat intelligence.

[Security Analysts]

#### **Security Analysts**

Move up from daily tasks to high-level strategic defense, threat hunting, and leadership roles.

[Aspiring CISOs]

#### **Aspiring CISOs**

Learn governance, budgeting, and security operations leadership to transition into decision-maker
roles.

### Certification?

Demand is growing across every vertical that depends on digital operations — and ACSMI-certified
professionals are equipped to lead across them all.

Protecting your digital assets with world-class security services

[ Get Started ][12] [ Learn More ][13]
Our Expertise

## Comprehensive IT & Security Solutions

As a premier system integrator, we deliver end-to-end technology solutions tailored to your needs

### Cybersecurity Services

Red Team Operations, Penetration Testing, Blue Team Defense, Incident Response, and 24/7 SOC
monitoring to protect your organization from sophisticated threats.

[ Explore Services ][14]

### Network Solutions

Enterprise network design, architecture, security, wireless solutions, and LAN/WAN management with
multi-vendor expertise and best practices.

[ Explore Services ][15]

### IT Infrastructure

Cloud services, virtualization, server & storage solutions, IT consultancy, and managed IT services
for optimal performance and reliability.

[ Explore Services ][16]

### Governance, Risk & Compliance

ISO 27001, NCA ECC, GDPR, SOC2 compliance, policy development, security audits, and comprehensive
risk assessments.

[ Explore Services ][17]

### Web & Mobile Development

Custom web applications, mobile apps for iOS and Android, progressive web apps, and full-stack
development with modern frameworks.

[ Explore Services ][18]

### UI/UX Design

User-centered design, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, design systems, and usability testing
for exceptional digital experiences.

# **Create A Beautiful Portfolio &
# Automatically Back Up Your Work**

Authory aggregates everything you've ever written or recorded and generates a beautiful portfolio
page so you can showcase, share, and save your life's work.
[
Create your portfolio in 5 minutes
][5]
Free plan available
No credit card required
Cancel anytime
...or take a look at Authory's features:
[
Portfolio

][6]
[
Archive

][7]
[

][8]
[
Tracking

][9]
[
Collections

[

All of your work. All in one place. Automatically.
Don't waste any more time creating PDFs of articles, tinkering with a website builder, or compiling
hyperlinks to webpages, podcasts, and content that could disappear at any moment. Get a fully
updated, easy-to-share portfolio that will win you new work while showcasing what you've already
done.
**1. Keep your life's work safe even when sites go dark.**

## **Automate your backups **
## (past, present, and future)

Authory constantly searches for your published content, automatically backing it up to your
portfolio when we find it. You get an searchable archive of your work that you can download anytime.

## Import your **Website, Email, and PDF** work samples

Website and emails are difficult to showcase. But not anymore! Authory will automatically take
screenshots and add them to your account. Plus, you can upload your PDFs, too!
**2. Show-off your experience without building an entire website.**

## Create a **self-updating portfolio**

Our self-updating portfolio includes everything you've published (articles, podcasts, and videos)
and looks for future media under your name, populating it for you automatically.

## Send and share your **most relevant work samples**

Curate your content to create sharable and embeddable collections that are specific to topic, media
type, publication, and more. You can also embed your Authory page within your existing personal
website to make them easy to find.
**3. Stay on top of your publications even when editors can't.**

## Know when your **content is published**

Often we're the first to tell customers their articles have gone live. We send you notifications as
we find your work and help you keep track of when and where it appears.

## Keep your **audience up-to-date**

Make it easy for readers to follow your work. Send automated email digests with a daily or weekly
newsletter that links to your latest content.
**4. Perfect your pitch with a tool as flexible as you are.**

## **Robust analytics** you'll always have access to

Get social media analytics for all your content (even if it's under another brand's name) and more
easily monitor your work's reach, traction, and social media interactions.

## Create **custom collections**

Quickly organize your content for each area of focus so you can send a custom page with each pitch,
job application, partnership, and more.
**We keep your content safe.** That's a promise.

Our only goal at Authory is to help you and your audience. That's why...

**Ad- and AI-free,** forever
Authory doesn't sell your data, neither to PR firms nor to AI companies.

Your data is safe with us. No hidden agendas here.
**Copyrights?** Check
All content added to your Authory account is treated as private (it's 100% copyright compliant), and
you're the only one who can access the full-text backup. We will not republish your content.
**No lock in,** ever
We don't lock you in. You can export your entire archive of content at any time and we'll send it to
you as an XML or HTML file.

Read more about copyright and ownership [here][12].

**We're for the writers, the creators, the storytellers;**
for those creating something worth saving.

We know that as a writer and content creator, your work doesn't end with the final draft. There's
working with your team to get it live, reviewing analytics, pitching new projects. Not to mention
trying to stay afloat when websites go dark, publication cadence increases, and some people just
can't tell the difference between automated text and great writing.

That's why we built Authory. So you can more easily find, back up, browse, showcase, and share all
of the work you've ever done.

Rated 4,8/5 stars

Ready to get started?
Create your portfolio now

### An education story

During a crowded lunch period, tension flares between students. Body worn cameras are a signal for
accountability from the start, encouraging calmer behavior as staff step in. If a parent later
raises concerns about the response, authentic footage protects staff from unwarranted accusations
and liability.

Administrators can review video for training to show staff what an effective response looks like in
a high‑energy environment. What begins as a disruption turns into an opportunity to improve
readiness and strengthen transparency—reassuring families of a commitment to student safety and
honest responses.

[A retail story]

### A retail story

A checkout line turns tense when a customer raises their voice toward an employee. But the moment
they notice the employee's body worn camera, the atmosphere changes. While discreet, its presence is
a reminder for all that the situation can be recorded, de‑escalating the customer and giving the
employee peace of mind.

The recording protects the store from liability while demonstrating staff compliance with safety
regulations. Portions of the footage are also used for training, so employees learn how to respond
swiftly and appropriately to incidents. By combining evidence, accountability, and education, the
retailer reinforces employee safety and confidence.

When delivering a warrant, officers activate their body worn cameras and initiate live streaming.
Everything officers see and hear is recorded and viewed in real time by command staff.

If questions arise, high‑definition, tamper‑proof footage provides verification of events and
officer actions. Clear audio and video are critical evidence in internal reviews and the courtroom,
strengthening transparency and reinforcing community trust in how the department handles potentially
high-risk operations.

## Law
## Enforcement

We  specialize  in delivering comprehensive body-worn camera programs to law enforcement agencies
nationwide. With decades of proven success across policing, we understand the critical role
body-worn cameras play in officer safety, accountability, and community trust. We provide end-to-end
support—including redaction, policy development, procurement, training, IT integration, secure
storage, and compliance—to help agencies manage reliable, modern, and transparent body-worn camera
programs.

[Tall Buildings]

## Commercial &
## Enterprise

The commercial market is now entering the same stage law enforcement faced over two decades
ago—recognizing the necessity of body-worn cameras to protect employees, reduce liability, and build
transparency and public trust. As private industries begin implementing these programs, BWC
Solutions guides organizations through every step of the process. From selecting the right equipment
to building policies, workflows, training, auditing, and secure storage, we assist companies to
confidently adopt body-worn camera programs that enhance safety, elevate accountability, and
safeguard operations.

### Lt. Colby Dolly

St. Louis County Police

"It’s a huge financial commitment when you select a vendor and you go with your outfit, in our case
700 officers, with these [Coreforce body-worn] cameras,” said Dolly. “So, the one thing I would say
is you have to have the officers use the technology. The last thing you want is for them to not
fully use the technology after you’ve committed all these resources to it. So, the question then is
how you get them to do that? You have to be very clear about your policies and what the expectations
are of the officers."

### Lt. Cameron Kovacs

Paradise Police Department

"There are many options out there, but Coreforce's innovation with their uniform integrated BWC
platform and their Digital Evidence Management solution, makes their unique approach, demands
attention."

### Chief Onesimo “Mo” Lopez

City of Bellaire Police Department

"One of the most essential features that I found with Coreforce was the officer down feature… back
in 2016, we had an officer die in the line of duty… If we had that in place in 2016, we would have
found that officer more quickly."

### Chief George Simpson

Polson Police Department

"By far the best customer service for public safety technologies, from the sales persons, to the
trainers, to the installers, and help desk they really are knowledgeable, helpful, and accessible
folks."

### Lt. Brian Adams

Osceola County FL Sheriff’s Office

"I think that society as a whole believes that law enforcement are good people,” said Adams, “but
the media sensationalizes every time an deputy does something wrong. When’s the last time you heard
about doing something right? So, while having these cameras helps protect and vindicate us, it also
helps us put some of the good stories out."

### Capt. Matthew Whalen

DeWitt Police Department

"The capabilities and features that Coreforce offers on their body cameras seemed to exceed those of
their competitors. One of nicest capabilities is the wireless upload of videos to the cloud from
both our body cameras as well as our in-car video. Coreforce provides the DeWitt Police Department
with a secure, easy to use platform that allows us to easily share video with the prosecutor’s
office."

### Chief Brad Flynn

Helena Police Department

"The technology, not just in the cameras, but in officer safety, the value in the authority they
place on officer’s lives. That really spoke to me."

### Assistant Chief Chris Bailey

Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department

"It was so important for us to take as much of that decision-making off the hands of the officer and
put it into the technology. I can’t say that it removes all implicit bias, but I know that having
[body cameras] automatically turn on is a good thing for our cops, and it’s a good thing for our
community."

## Other Technologies
## Fall Short

Current AI image recognition algorithms require ~40% of an image to match, and can easily be fooled
by simply rotating, blurring, or partially cropping an image. What was once visually similar is now
seen as something else, potentially unclassifiable, and the image “fingerprint” is no longer
accurate due to the inability to recognize an image beyond simple transformations.

## **Security Starts with Behavior**

A new class of insiders is emerging. AI agents now act alongside human employees, often at machine
speed and massive scale. Traditional security tools were not built to see or understand this
behavior. To keep pace, security teams need a combination of human
insight and digital-speed intelligence to monitor, govern, and secure this evolving workforce while
simultaneously leveraging its power for accelerated security operations.

****AI Agent-Powered TDIR****

Automate and accelerate threat detection, investigation and response (TDIR). An integrated team of
AI agents streamlines the entire TDIR workflow, from enriching threat data to building
evidence-backed timelines. Experience faster and more precise investigations, increasing team
productivity.

[target]

****Insider Threat Coverage for Humans and Agents****

Monitor behavior of both employees and AI agents to gain visibility into this new class of insider
threat. User and entity behavior analytics (UEBA) and Agent Behavior Analytics (ABA) automatically
baseline activity, exposing anomalies that signal an actionable threat.

[outcomes]

****Quantifiable, Outcomes-Focused Security****

Benchmark and prove the value of your security program against peers and measurable outcomes.
Translate raw security data into business-relevant insights to demonstrate progress against your
most strategic use cases, MITRE ATT&CK TTPs, and compliance initiatives.

****Unmatched Customer Choice and Flexibility****

Maximize your investment in best-of-breed security tools with an open platform. Gain a unified view
of your security operation without getting locked into a proprietary scheme. Control costs with
advanced data pipeline management that allows you to search data in place and leverage low-cost
storage.

GDH is a global IT staffing and professional services firm committed to always delivering more.
Better talent. More client support. World-class workforce outcomes. Let’s get to work.

Discover the many reasons to make GDH your career partner. We care about people. We will take you as
far as your professional ambitions reach.

# Product Series

[ All Products ][28]

### Body worn cameras

Equipped with a powerful eight core processor, supporting AI intelligent recognition; Capture the
entire process of law enforcement on-site, and transmit 1080P high-definition video in real-time;

[ Know more][29]

### Helmet cameras

H8 is a fully rugged helmet wearable smart video camera, which equipped with Andoid 8.1 Octa-core
system, built-in 4G/WIFI/GPS, high definition 20MP camera, speaker/microphone can be used to capture
photos and videos in hard-to-reach places like tunnels, towers, construction buildings or behind
large machinery/equipment or etc

[ Know more][30]

### POC radios

F39 is a compact, rugged, and easy-to-operate large screen handheld radio which enables Push-to-Talk
over Cellular using Wi-Fi and the existing 3G/4G/LTE infrastructure of Mobile Network Operators

[ Know more][31]

### AR Glasses

Designed specifically for safe production supervision scenarios, the 4G AR glasses integrates
advanced 4G connectivity, AI intelligence, and AR visualization technology, redefining the
interactive mode of on-site operations and setting a new benchmark for intelligent wearable
equipment in industrial safety fields.

[ Know more][32]

### Docking station

Suitable for handling heavy data storage, it can automatically complete intelligent collection,
monitoring, classification, conversion, and upload of terminal data. Data storage is safe and
efficient, effectively liberating manpower, reducing manual intervention, and greatly saving time.

[ Know more][33]

### Software platform

Multimedia command and dispatch station software is a professional dispatching station software
launched for industry users. The integrated audio and video dispatching greatly improves the ease of
use and convenience of dispatching operations

[ Know more][34]
solutions
Public safety

Grandtime broadband solutions not only provide key voice services, but also devote more energy to
reliable video transmission and data transmission to help customers cope with more complex
scenarios.

 

#### **Improving Transparency and Response Capability**

Grandtime provides connected solutions for police, emergency response and security organizations.

 

Applications:
* Body worn camera deployment
* Evidence management
* Field communication
* Real-time command support

[Know more][35]
Public transport

Buses, trams, subways, railways, and high-speed trains, including the most modern driverless
systems, need efficient communications systems that provide the availability and security
specifications required by these environments.


[Know more][36]
Energy

Electricity, gas and water utility companies with distribution failures immediately disrupt both
consumers and the economy.  Utility companies sometimes have distribution networks comprising of
thousands of kilometres of infrastructure, overhead lines and sub-station assets in locations with
very little coverage due to being based in remote uneven terrain areas.

 

#### **Enabling Safer and More Efficient Field Operations**

Energy companies operate in complex environments where rapid communication and expert support are
essential.

 

Applications:
* Remote inspection
* Equipment maintenance
* Safety monitoring
* Expert collaboration

[Know more][37]
Construction

A synthesis of activity, personnel, assets, equipment, and machinery, construction sites face many
complicated challenges.  Challenges such as personnel mobility and complex vehicle management.  The
costs, the pressure, and the stakes, are high.

 

#### Making Job Sites Safer and More Connected

Grandtime solutions help construction teams improve communication and supervision across large and
distributed sites.

 

Applications:
* Site monitoring
* Safety management
* Remote assistance
* Project coordination

# About us

Shenzhen Grandtime Technology Co., Ltd. founded in 2014, located in Nanshan high-tech park,
Shenzhen. We specialise in providing hardware and software development in the field of public safety
and enterprise worker safety for our customers across the globe. We focus on research, development,
and manufacturing of police law enforcement terminals 4G/5G body worn cameras, intelligent 4G public
network cluster terminals 4G POC radios, intelligent safety helmets, and other intelligent device
terminals. For over a decade, we have been committed to solve various safety issues in urban public
safety governance and people's lives in a scientific manner that is data-driven, visualized, and
intelligent, and to provide efficient, customizable intelligent, visualized, and data-driven
solutions for the government, law enforcement departments and industry related to public safety and
worker safety.

# About us

Shenzhen Grandtime Technology Co., Ltd. founded in 2014, located in Nanshan high-tech park,
Shenzhen. We specialise in providing hardware and software development in the field of public safety

and manufacturing of police law enforcement terminals 4G/5G body worn cameras, intelligent 4G public

The most reliable and rugged industrial remote control solutions[John
Chung][34]2026-06-29T19:12:47+08:00

# RADIO REMOTE CONTROLS

We design and manufacture highly configurable industrial radio remote controls for demanding
machinery applications. Built for complex working environments, HOVST systems support safer
operation, dependable control, and higher operational efficiency.

[ DISCOVER OUR PRODUCTS ][35]

## WIRELESS CONTROL FOR DEMANDING MACHINERY

Give operators the freedom to work from the position with the clearest view of the machine, load,
and surrounding work area. HOVST wireless controls remove restrictive pendant cables and help keep
operators focused on the job.

[ EXPLORE APPLICATIONS ][36]

### Wireless remote control solutions


# industrial remote control

Hovst wireless remote machine control solutions are engineered to raise the bar on quality,
durability, and dependability. Our line up of ruggedized handhelds and belly pack systems withstand
the harshest work site conditions while delivering the precision control required to get the job
done.

[Extreme Sports Bike]
[ [HOVST Pro-X wireless hydraulic retrofit kits for manual spool valves] ][37]

### Pro-X™ Hydraulic Retrofit Kits

Wireless proportional control for manual hydraulic spool valves.

[Learn More][38]
[ [HOVST Titan-R dual joystick belly box remote controller] ][39]

### Titan-R™ Belly Box Controllers

Professional belly pack control for electro-hydraulic systems.

[Learn More][40]
[ [HOVST Vision-X handheld transmitter with display feedback] ][41]

### Vision-X™ Display Remotes

Display-based remote control with two-way data feedback.

[Learn More][42]
[ [HOVST Command-Q industrial button remote control for cranes and hoists] ][43]

### Command-Q™ Industrial Button Series

Button-type radio control for overhead cranes, hoists, and winches.

[Learn More][44]
[HOVST industrial radio remote control product lineup]

## A universal remote.

HOVST industrial wireless remote control systems are designed for hydraulic machinery, cranes,
hoists, winches, tarp systems, dump trailers, and truck-mounted equipment. With flexible function
mapping and application-specific configuration, one remote control platform can be adapted across
different machines while keeping operation simple and reliable.

[ Reduce Your Inventory ][45]

### Upgrade with ease

HOVST retrofit kits make it easier to upgrade manual hydraulic controls or replace outdated remote
control systems without redesigning the whole machine.

[ Our Products ][46]
[Operator using a HOVST industrial wireless remote control]

## About HOVST

HOVST develops wireless remote control solutions for industrial equipment and mobile hydraulic
machinery. Our systems help operators work from a safer position while maintaining precise control
of the equipment they rely on every day.

From truck-mounted cranes and log loaders to dump trailers, tarp systems, overhead cranes, and
concrete pump trucks, HOVST remote controls are designed around real operating conditions, clear
control logic

control logic, and dependable machine response.

integrating a remote solution into new equipment, HOVST provides practical control architectures

functions to rugged enclosures and dependable wireless performance, every detail is designed to help
operators work with greater confidence in demanding industrial environments.

Speeding remains a significant threat to road safety, putting lives and communities at risk. Law
enforcement officers play a crucial role in curbing this danger by apprehending offending drivers.

solid evidence that stands up in court. All too often, prosecutions of all types of crimes,
including speeding and other dangerous traffic violations, are thwarted due to a lack of, or lost
evidence.

## How to book cheap tickets with LNER
* ### Book your train tickets in advance
  
  Buy a Standard Advance ticket through the LNER website and app at least four weeks before you
  travel, and you'll save up to 47%* compared to buying any Standard ticket on the day of travel.
  
  [Book in advance][147]
* ### Save 1/3 with on your train tickets with a railcard
  
  A railcard is a discount card that allows you to save money on train travel throughout Great
  Britain, which often offers 1/3 off the cost of your train tickets on most routes.
  
  [Railcards][148]
* ### Save 77%** on train tickets with Family tickets
  
  Travel between 17 cities and save on average 77%** when you're travelling with up to two adults
  and four children. Use one Family ticket for the whole family and get a reserved seat for
  everyone.
  
  [Family Singles][149]

# Home

Auto Theft Prevention

Auto theft is a growing problem across Niagara. 

For information on how to help protect your vehicle,

keep your belongings safe, and what to do if your vehicle

is stolen, please visit our [Auto Theft Preventio][82][n][83] page.

[ Auto Theft Prevention ][84]

NRPS Traffic Hotline

The traffic hotline is a direct line that allows individuals to leave information about 
areas where there are road safety concerns. These can include speed related issues
or other Highway Traffic Act violations, where a greater police presence is required.

To report a concern, call: 289-248-1060

Please note, this does not replace emergency services or collision reporting.
In case of emergency, please call 911. 

Considering a Career in Policing?

We're always looking for qualified individuals to join our Service. 

To learn more about requirements, qualifications,

and the application process, visit our recruiting page.

[ Learn More ][85]

Neighbourhood Watch Program

Neighbourhood Watch is about neighbours looking out for neighbours.  The Niagara Regional Police
Service supports community-led initiatives that promote awareness, reporting, and prevention while
ensuring safety and accountability. 

Neighbourhood Watch is primarily an online platform for communities to share information, look out
for one another and help mitigate risks in their communities.

[ Neighbourhood Watch ][86]

Community Safety Survey

The Niagara Police Service Board, in collaboration with the Niagara Regional Police Service
are asking residents to help shape the future of community safety by participating in a new
Community Safety Survey aimed at identifying community priorities and opportunities to strengthen
policing and public safety across Niagara.

[ Community Safety Survey ][87]

[
[hands typing on a computer]

Report Online

Report a non-emergency online 24/7. From the convenience of your smartphone or computer you can
quickly submit a variety of reports.

In case of emergency, please call 911.

Auto theft is a growing problem across Niagara. 

For information on how to help protect your vehicle,

keep your belongings safe, and what to do if your vehicle

is stolen, please visit our [Auto Theft Preventio][82][n][83] page.

[ Auto Theft Prevention ][84]

NRPS Traffic Hotline

The traffic hotline is a direct line that allows individuals to leave information about 
areas where there are road safety concerns. These can include speed related issues
or other Highway Traffic Act violations, where a greater police presence is required.

To report a concern, call: 289-248-1060

Please note, this does not replace emergency services or collision reporting.
In case of emergency, please call 911. 

Considering a Career in Policing?

We're always looking for qualified individuals to join our Service. 

To learn more about requirements, qualifications,

and the application process, visit our recruiting page.

[ Learn More ][85]

Neighbourhood Watch Program

Neighbourhood Watch is about neighbours looking out for neighbours.  The Niagara Regional Police
Service supports community-led initiatives that promote awareness, reporting, and prevention while
ensuring safety and accountability. 

Neighbourhood Watch is primarily an online platform for communities to share information, look out
for one another and help mitigate risks in their communities.

[ Neighbourhood Watch ][86]

Community Safety Survey

The Niagara Police Service Board, in collaboration with the Niagara Regional Police Service
are asking residents to help shape the future of community safety by participating in a new
Community Safety Survey aimed at identifying community priorities and opportunities to strengthen
policing and public safety across Niagara.

[ Community Safety Survey ][87]

[hands typing on a computer]

Report Online

Report a non-emergency online 24/7. From the convenience of your smartphone or computer you can
quickly submit a variety of reports.

In case of emergency, please call 911.

## You ask, we answer

What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

FAQ

## You ask, we answer

Cloud Services
Cyber Security
Data Center Solutions
Digital Transformation
End User Computing
IMS
What kind of networking and content delivery solutions does Orient Technologies Limited offer?

Orient Technologies Limited offers a range of networking and content delivery network solutions.

What industries do you cater to?

We provide Cloud services to a wide range of industries, including Pharmaceutical, Healthcare, BFSI,
ITeS, Government-PSU and more.

How can a company prepare for cloud to cloud migration?

A company can prepare for cloud to cloud migration by performing a comprehensive inventory of its
current infrastructure, data, and applications, identifying potential compatibility issues or data
migration challenges, selecting a compatible cloud provider, and developing a migration plan that
includes testing and risk management measures

How can a company ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration?

A company can ensure data security during cloud to cloud migration by using encryption and secure
transfer protocols, implementing access controls and user authentication measures, and performing
regular security audits and risk assessments.

How can Orient Technologies Limited help us migrate our existing applications and data to the cloud?

Our team of experts can assist you with the planning, execution, and testing of your migration to
the cloud. We also offer automated tools and services to help you migrate your applications and data
quickly and efficiently.

What sets your cybersecurity solutions apart from competitors?

Full-spectrum Cybersecurity Solutions - From Cybersecurity Awareness, endpoint security to Cloud
Security and everything in between, Proactive threat intelligence, reducing vulnerabilities before
they escalate, Customizable security layers based on your unique business needs, Strategic
consulting through vCISO services, ensuring leadership-driven security frameworks, Cost-effective
scalability, offering enterprise-level security to businesses of all sizes.

What’s the ROI of investing in cybersecurity with Cyber Solutions?

Businesses that invest in proactive cybersecurity measures reduce breach costs by an average of 70%.

What industries benefit the most from your cybersecurity solutions?

Healthcare (PHI - protecting personal health information), Finance (Aligning with regulatory
compliances; safeguarding critical information assets), Retail & E-commerce (preventing data theft
and securing payment systems), Technology (safeguarding intellectual property), SMBs and enterprises
facing evolving digital threats.

How do your solutions ensure compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, or PCI DSS?

Our solutions are designed with compliance at their core. We offer frameworks and automated tools to
ensure your security practices align with industry regulations, minimizing risk and preventing
costly breaches.

How do you protect remote workforces and endpoints?

Through advanced Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions, we secure devices across remote
environments.

How do I know which cybersecurity service is right for my business?

We offer a cyber risk assessment and an initial consultation to evaluate your current security
posture.

Can your solutions integrate with our existing security infrastructure?

Yes! Our services are designed to integrate seamlessly with your existing technology stack.

## Advance press freedom — protect democracy.

At this challenging moment, the Reporters Committee remains a dedicated and fierce advocate for our
free press and the First Amendment. Your donations empower us to defend journalists in court, fight
for open records and greater transparency, and advocate for press freedom protections nationwide.
And, as always, our work on behalf of reporters and newsrooms is done free of charge. Right now, no
investment is more important than our democracy — please give generously.

## Advance press freedom — protect democracy.

At this challenging moment, the Reporters Committee remains a dedicated and fierce advocate for our
free press and the First Amendment. Your donations empower us to defend journalists in court, fight
for open records and greater transparency, and advocate for press freedom protections nationwide.
And, as always, our work on behalf of reporters and newsrooms is done free of charge. Right now, no
investment is more important than our democracy — please give generously.

[DONATE NOW][96]

## Decision Over Chaos

Embracing Agentic AI

Security teams are drowning in alerts while attackers move faster than ever. Securonix Unified
Defense SIEM uses an Agentic Mesh of specialized AI agents to help teams decide and act across the
threat lifecycle with speed, context, and control.
* Unified detection and response across data sources
* AI-driven anomaly detection with context
* Pre-built content and playbooks

**
The Result:** Security teams improve response times by up to 60 percent.


[SEE HOW][162]

## Alerts to Action

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Traditional SIEMs generate volume. Modern security demands outcomes. As threats grow more complex,
teams need systems that reason, prioritize, and guide response in real time.

Powered by an Agentic Mesh, Securonix coordinates AI agents across detection, investigation, and
response to turn signals into guided decisions with human oversight.

With Securonix:
* Reduce alert noise and surface validated risk
* Accelerate investigations with contextual guidance
* Strengthen breach readiness across the environment
* Elevate SOC Analysts from Level 1 to Level 2

[SEE HOW][163]

## Productivity Instead of Noise

The AI SOC Analyst

Sam, the AI SOC Analyst, operates across the Unified Defense platform, analyzing behavior,
understanding context, and recommending actions across detection, investigation, and response.
Always learning. Always accountable. Always human-guided.

With Sam:
* Automated alert triage and prioritization
* Contextual enrichment using identity, behavior, and threat intelligence
* Investigation summaries that eliminate manual pivoting
* Case preparation for escalation and response
* Executive- and board-ready security summaries


[MEET SAM][164]

## Unified Defense SIEM’s Powerful Features

Securonix unifies analytics, threat intelligence, investigation, and response into a single
cloud-native platform designed for scale, precision, and speed. The Agentic Mesh orchestrates these
capabilities as one coordinated system.

## Threat Intelligence That Drives Action

Threat intelligence only matters when it improves decisions. Securonix transforms intelligence into
operational context by enriching detections, prioritizing risk, and guiding response across your
environment.
* Native intelligence ingestion and enrichment
* MITRE ATT&CK aligned context
* Integrated ThreatQ capabilities

[LEARN MORE][165]

## Less reporting. More investigation.

ThreatQ, now part of Securonix, brings curated threat intelligence into the Securonix security
operations portfolio. It centralizes, enriches, and prioritizes intelligence from internal and
external sources so teams can improve detection quality, accelerate investigations, and respond with
stronger context.

With ThreatQ, teams can:
* Unify threat intelligence across SOC, CTI, and IR workflows
* Enrich and prioritize indicators with relevant context
* Operationalize intelligence across SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, and firewalls
* Strengthen Securonix AI-driven detection and response


[SEE HOW][166]

## Trusted by Global Security Leaders

Evolving to the Agentic SOC

Enterprises and MSSPs rely on Securonix to modernize security operations, reduce operational risk,
and move from reactive response to proactive, intelligence-driven defense. And there’s a reason for
that:

**Six-Time Consecutive Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SIEM**
Consistently recognized for completeness of vision and ability to execute, reflecting sustained
innovation, architectural strength, and customer trust.

**Two-Time Customers’ Choice on Gartner Peer Insights™**
Validated directly by security practitioners for product capabilities, deployment experience, and
measurable operational value.

Together, these recognitions reflect both strategic leadership and real-world impact for Enterprises
and MSSPs.

stronger context.

WE PROTECT GREAT COMPANIES AND THEIR PEOPLE

Your organization is unique. But all too often, cost concerns force mid-market companies to settle
for cookie cutter solutions. Silent Sector provides unbiased vendor and technology-neutral
cybersecurity assessments, guidance, managed cybersecurity services, and program implementation to
keep your company compliant and ahead of the threats. We design solutions for mid-market and
emerging companies in the healthcare, financial services, technology, education, manufacturing, and
defense industries.

### Expertise Impact Methodology

Our experts become an extension of your organization

Silent Sector's unique Expertise Impact Model™ streamlines cost and response time by putting you in
direct contact with the experts you need.  Using an asymmetrical warfare approach based on US Army

external resources.  This force multiplication methodology also focuses on getting the most value
from your existing software and hardware.  It’s how Silent Sector delivers the high level of
proficiency typically only available to large enterprises, right-sized for the budgets of mid-market
and emerging organizations who need it most.

## Media Coverage

[photofocus logo]

What I like most about the SJ30 is that it feels practical. It’s not trying too hard to be an
ultra-premium cinema camera replacement, and it’s not overloaded with features nobody will
realistically use. Instead, it feels like a genuinely useful everyday creator camera. Small enough
to carry everywhere. Simple enough to use quickly. Capable enough to create very solid content. It
is super easy to switch the magnetic hand from horizontal to vertical mode. It comes with loads of
connectors.

[creativebloq logo]

The SJCAM C300 is perfect for anyone who wants a decent action camera without the high price. This
compact camera has plenty of features that will attract content creators, including being able to
record 4K footage at 30fps and a built-in electronic image stabilisation (EIS) system to help smooth
out footage shot in action.

[bnnbreaking logo]

In the dynamic world of action cameras, SJCAM has made a bold move by unveiling its innovative SJ20
action camera. Equipped with a dual-lens setup and advanced night vision capabilities, this new
entrant is well-positioned to challenge the supremacy of the GoPro series.

[mac sources logo]

The SJCAM C300 Action Camera is a versatile and reliable choice for capturing your adventures. With
its waterproof and durable construction, it can withstand even the most extreme conditions. The
high-quality image and video resolution ensure that you capture every detail in stunning clarity.

[thepinoytraveler logo]

The SJ4000 WIFI is a worth-buying action camera. It is waterproof (to 30 feet) which makes a great
pick for water adventures such as surfing, snorkeling and rafting or even free diving. The SJ4000
WIFI has also amazing features same like other expensive action camera.

[onmsft logo]

The SJCAM C200 is a nice GoPro alternative. The design is durable. Video quality is also good, and
the stabilization and sensors onboard mean that your action footage will come out looking amazing.

[pocnetwork logo]

This is the new SJCAM C300 4K Action Camera and it comes with some decent features while also
packing some entry-level stabilization to add to your experience.

[AGR logo]

The amazing 4K footage at this price is a big plus, as is the excellent touchscreen display and
seamless navigation. A lot of cameras fail to deliver in this area, but the SJ8 Pro exceeds
expectations.

[Gadget review logo]

The SJCAM SJ8 Pro action camera has a superb mix of price and features. It comes at a low price but
still has 4K recording with electronic stabilization, and 12 MP images with 8x zoom.

[camera jabber logo]

Out of the packaging and housing and the camera instantly seems impressive, it feels good and has an
excellent weight and build quality.

## For Your Different Needs

## Media Coverage

[photofocus logo]

What I like most about the SJ30 is that it feels practical. It’s not trying too hard to be an
ultra-premium cinema camera replacement, and it’s not overloaded with features nobody will
realistically use. Instead, it feels like a genuinely useful everyday creator camera. Small enough
to carry everywhere. Simple enough to use quickly. Capable enough to create very solid content. It
is super easy to switch the magnetic hand from horizontal to vertical mode. It comes with loads of
connectors.

[creativebloq logo]

The SJCAM C300 is perfect for anyone who wants a decent action camera without the high price. This
compact camera has plenty of features that will attract content creators, including being able to
record 4K footage at 30fps and a built-in electronic image stabilisation (EIS) system to help smooth
out footage shot in action.

[bnnbreaking logo]

In the dynamic world of action cameras, SJCAM has made a bold move by unveiling its innovative SJ20
action camera. Equipped with a dual-lens setup and advanced night vision capabilities, this new
entrant is well-positioned to challenge the supremacy of the GoPro series.

[mac sources logo]

The SJCAM C300 Action Camera is a versatile and reliable choice for capturing your adventures. With
its waterproof and durable construction, it can withstand even the most extreme conditions. The
high-quality image and video resolution ensure that you capture every detail in stunning clarity.

[thepinoytraveler logo]

The SJ4000 WIFI is a worth-buying action camera. It is waterproof (to 30 feet) which makes a great
pick for water adventures such as surfing, snorkeling and rafting or even free diving. The SJ4000
WIFI has also amazing features same like other expensive action camera.

[onmsft logo]

The SJCAM C200 is a nice GoPro alternative. The design is durable. Video quality is also good, and
the stabilization and sensors onboard mean that your action footage will come out looking amazing.

[pocnetwork logo]

This is the new SJCAM C300 4K Action Camera and it comes with some decent features while also
packing some entry-level stabilization to add to your experience.

[AGR logo]

The amazing 4K footage at this price is a big plus, as is the excellent touchscreen display and
seamless navigation. A lot of cameras fail to deliver in this area, but the SJ8 Pro exceeds
expectations.

[Gadget review logo]

The SJCAM SJ8 Pro action camera has a superb mix of price and features. It comes at a low price but
still has 4K recording with electronic stabilization, and 12 MP images with 8x zoom.

[camera jabber logo]

Out of the packaging and housing and the camera instantly seems impressive, it feels good and has an
excellent weight and build quality.

strong software and hardware R&D capabilities. Tuqiang’s founders and core team members have more
than 20 years of experience in the IoT industry and are veritable industry veterans. They not only
founded Tuqiang, but also founded or co-founded many brands that are among the best in various IoT
segments.

### security products
* [banner]
  
  #### Access Control
  
  Access control is the first and most powerful component of facility safety and security, and Tyco
  offers a comprehensive array of access control platforms, solutions, and products.
  
  [Explore][183]
* [banner]
  
  #### Video Surveillance
  
  Modern security goes beyond the standard video infrastructure. Today's advanced technology allows
  operators to become the eyes and ears of buildings, enabling them to not only protect visitors and
  assets, but also achieve operational excellence.
  
  [Explore][184]
* [banner]
  
  #### Intrusion Detection
  
  When it comes to protecting a home, building, or commercial facility, intrusion protection is the
  first line of defense. Tyco offers a comprehensive set of technologically sophisticated security
  and alarm solutions that are easy to configure, install, and maintain. Most important, Tyco
  products work, adding a critical layer of security wherever it's needed.
  
  [Explore][185]

traffic.
